case_title: TAYAG RESTITUTO DBA OLD FASHION JANITORIAL VS SPUNTINO RESTAURANT et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY TAYAG RESTITUTO DBA OLD FASHION JANITORIAL AS TO DEFENDANT SPUNTINO RESTAURANT ATTENTION MARK MANAGER ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-26-1991 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT SPUNTINO RESTAURANT

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TAYAG RESTITUTO DBA OLD FASHION JANITORIAL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SPUNTINO RESTAURANT ATTENTION MARK MANAGER STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
